description: This Java source file defines the enum RenderPreviewMode, which manages different preview configurations in the Android layout editor, including modes like DEFAULT, LOCALES, SCREENS, and methods for managing current mode and deleted preview IDs.

classes.name: RenderPreviewMode
classes.description: An enum representing different modes for rendering previews in the Android layout editor, with static methods to manage current mode and deleted IDs, and instance method to check for device frame inclusion.

methods.name: getCurrent
methods.description: Returns the current render preview mode.

methods.name: setCurrent
methods.description: Sets the current render preview mode; resets deleted IDs if mode changes.

methods.name: isDeletedId
methods.description: Checks if a given preview ID has been marked as deleted.

methods.name: deleteId
methods.description: Marks a preview ID as deleted, affecting its visibility across layout switches.

methods.name: showsDeviceFrames
methods.description: Indicates whether the current preview mode includes device frames around layouts.
